reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7432, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏تَعْرُجُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ ـ أَوْ أَبِي نُعْمٍ شَكَّ قَبِيصَةُ ـ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ بُعِثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذُهَيْبَةٍ فَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَ أَرْبَعَةٍ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ بَعَثَ عَلِيٌّ وَهْوَ بِالْيَمَنِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذُهَيْبَةٍ فِي تُرْبَتِهَا، فَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَ الأَقْرَعِ بْنِ حَابِسٍ الْحَنْظَلِيِّ ثُمَّ أَحَدِ بَنِي مُجَاشِعٍ، وَبَيْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ بْنِ بَدْرٍ الْفَزَارِيِّ، وَبَيْنَ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ عُلاَثَةَ الْعَامِرِيِّ ثُمَّ أَحَدِ بَنِي كِلاَبٍ، وَبَيْنَ زَيْدِ الْخَيْلِ الطَّائِيِّ ثُمَّ أَحَدِ بَنِي نَبْهَانَ، فَتَغَضَّبَتْ قُرَيْشٌ وَالأَنْصَارُ فَقَالُوا يُعْطِيهِ صَنَادِيدَ أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ وَيَدَعُنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا أَتَأَلَّفُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ غَائِرُ الْعَيْنَيْنِ، نَاتِئُ الْجَبِينِ، كَثُّ اللِّحْيَةِ، مُشْرِفُ الْوَجْنَتَيْنِ، مَحْلُوقُ الرَّأْسِ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَمَنْ يُطِيعُ اللَّهَ إِذَا عَصَيْتُهُ فَيَأْمَنِّي عَلَى أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ، وَلاَ تَأْمَنُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ ـ قَتْلَهُ أُرَاهُ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ ـ فَمَنَعَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ ضِئْضِئِ هَذَا قَوْمًا يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يُجَاوِزُ حَنَاجِرَهُمْ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ مُرُوقَ السَّهْمِ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، يَقْتُلُونَ أَهْلَ الإِسْلاَمِ وَيَدَعُونَ أَهْلَ الأَوْثَانِ، لَئِنْ أَدْرَكْتُهُمْ لأَقْتُلَنَّهُمْ قَتْلَ عَادٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Qabisah narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn Abi Nuaim—or Abu Nuaim, Qabisah was uncertain—from Abu Said, who said: A small piece of gold was sent to the Prophet, and he divided it among four people. Ishaq ibn Nasr narrated to me; Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us; Sufyan informed us, from his father, from Ibn Abi Nuaim, from Abu Said al-Khudri, who said: Ali, while in Yemen, sent a small piece of gold in its ore to the Prophet. He divided it among al-Aqra ibn Habis al-Hanzali, one of Banu Mujashi; Uyaynah ibn Badr al-Fazari; Alqamah ibn Ulathah al-Amiri, one of Banu Kilab; and Zayd al-Khayl al-Ta’i, one of Banu Nabhan. Quraysh and the Ansar became angry and said, “He gives to the chiefs of Najd and leaves us?” He said: “I am only trying to draw them close.” A man with sunken eyes, a prominent forehead, a thick beard, and shaved head came forward and said, “Muhammad, fear Allah.” The Prophet said: “Who would obey Allah if I disobeyed Him? Would He entrust me with the people of the earth while you do not?” A man among the people asked permission to kill him—I think it was Khalid ibn al-Walid—but the Prophet stopped him. When the man turned away, the Prophet said: “From this man’s descendants will come a people who recite the Quran, but it will not pass beyond their throats. They will leave Islam as an arrow passes through its target. They will kill the Muslims and leave the idolaters. If I live to see them, I will kill them as the people of Ad were killed.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7433, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏تَعْرُجُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَوْلِهِ ‏[quran sura="36" aya_start="38" aya_end="38"]{‏وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهَا‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُسْتَقَرُّهَا تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ayyash ibn al-Walid narrated to us; Waki narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim al-Taymi, from his father, from Abu Dharr, who said: I asked the Prophet about Allah’s words, “The sun runs to its appointed course” (36:38). He said: “Its appointed course is beneath the Throne.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7434, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، وَهُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا الْقَمَرَ لاَ تُضَامُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُغْلَبُوا عَلَى صَلاَةٍ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَصَلاَةٍ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، فَافْعَلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Amr ibn Awn narrated to us; Khalid and Hushaym narrated to us, from Ismail, from Qays, from Jarir, who said: We were sitting with the Prophet when he looked at the full moon and said: “You will see your Lord as you see this moon, without crowding or difficulty in seeing Him. If you are able not to be overcome with regard to a prayer before sunrise and a prayer before sunset, then do so.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7435, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الْيَرْبُوعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ عِيَانًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yusuf ibn Musa narrated to us; Asim ibn Yusuf al-Yarbu’i narrated to us; Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, from Qays ibn Abi Hazim, from Jarir ibn Abdullah, who said: The Prophet said: “You will see your Lord with your own eyes.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7436, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْجُعْفِيُّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بَيَانُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، قَالَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا، لاَ تُضَامُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdah ibn Abdullah narrated to us; Husayn al-Jufi narrated to us, from Zaidah; Bayan ibn Bishr narrated to us, from Qays ibn Abi Hazim. Jarir narrated to us, who said: The Messenger of Allah came out to us on the night of the full moon and said: “You will see your Lord on the Day of Resurrection as you see this moon, without crowding or difficulty in seeing Him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7437, 7438, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّاسَ، قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي الشَّمْسِ لَيْسَ دُونَهَا سَحَابٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكُمْ تَرَوْنَهُ كَذَلِكَ، يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ شَيْئًا فَلْيَتَّبِعْهُ‏.‏ فَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الشَّمْسَ الشَّمْسَ، وَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الْقَمَرَ الْقَمَرَ، وَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الطَّوَاغِيتَ الطَّوَاغِيتَ، وَتَبْقَى هَذِهِ الأُمَّةُ فِيهَا شَافِعُوهَا ـ أَوْ مُنَافِقُوهَا شَكَّ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ـ فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللَّهُ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا مَكَانُنَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَنَا رَبُّنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَنَا رَبُّنَا عَرَفْنَاهُ فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللَّهُ فِي صُورَتِهِ الَّتِي يَعْرِفُونَ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ رَبُّنَا‏.‏ فَيَتْبَعُونَهُ وَيُضْرَبُ الصِّرَاطُ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَىْ جَهَنَّمَ، فَأَكُونُ أَنَا وَأُمَّتِي أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُجِيزُهَا، وَلاَ يَتَكَلَّمُ يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ الرُّسُلُ، وَدَعْوَى الرُّسُلِ يَوْمَئِذٍ اللَّهُمَّ سَلِّمْ سَلِّمْ‏.‏ وَفِي جَهَنَّمَ كَلاَلِيبُ مِثْلُ شَوْكِ السَّعْدَانِ، هَلْ رَأَيْتُمُ السَّعْدَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهَا مِثْلُ شَوْكِ السَّعْدَانِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا قَدْرُ عِظَمِهَا إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، تَخْطَفُ النَّاسَ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ، فَمِنْهُمُ الْمُوبَقُ بَقِيَ بِعَمَلِهِ، أَوِ الْمُوثَقُ بِعَمَلِهِ، وَمِنْهُمُ الْمُخَرْدَلُ أَوِ الْمُجَازَى أَوْ نَحْوُهُ، ثُمَّ يَتَجَلَّى حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ وَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ أَرَادَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ أَمَرَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ أَنْ يُخْرِجُوا مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ كَانَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَرْحَمَهُ مِمَّنْ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، فَيَعْرِفُونَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ بِأَثَرِ السُّجُودِ، تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ ابْنَ آدَمَ إِلاَّ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، فَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ قَدِ امْتُحِشُوا، فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَاءُ الْحَيَاةِ فَيَنْبُتُونَ تَحْتَهُ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ يَفْرُغُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ، وَيَبْقَى رَجُلٌ مُقْبِلٌ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَى النَّارِ هُوَ آخِرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ دُخُولاً الْجَنَّةَ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ اصْرِفْ وَجْهِي عَنِ النَّارِ، فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ قَشَبَنِي رِيحُهَا وَأَحْرَقَنِي ذَكَاؤُهَا‏.‏ فَيَدْعُو اللَّهَ بِمَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَهُ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ هَلْ عَسَيْتَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لاَ وَعِزَّتِكَ لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ غَيْرَهُ، وَيُعْطِي رَبَّهُ مِنْ عُهُودٍ وَمَوَاثِيقَ مَا شَاءَ، فَيَصْرِفُ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ النَّارِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَ عَلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَرَآهَا سَكَتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَسْكُتَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ قَدِّمْنِي إِلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلَسْتَ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتَ عُهُودَكَ وَمَوَاثِيقَكَ أَنْ لاَ تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَ الَّذِي أُعْطِيتَ أَبَدًا، وَيْلَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْدَرَكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ‏.‏ وَيَدْعُو اللَّهَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ هَلْ عَسَيْتَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لاَ وَعِزَّتِكَ لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ غَيْرَهُ، وَيُعْطِي مَا شَاءَ مِنْ عُهُودٍ وَمَوَاثِيقَ، فَيُقَدِّمُهُ إِلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ، فَإِذَا قَامَ إِلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ انْفَهَقَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ فَرَأَى مَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْحَبْرَةِ وَالسُّرُورِ، فَيَسْكُتُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَسْكُتَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَلَسْتَ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتَ عُهُودَكَ وَمَوَاثِيقَكَ أَنْ لاَ تَسْأَلَ غَيْرَ مَا أُعْطِيتَ ـ فَيَقُولُ ـ وَيْلَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْدَرَكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ لاَ أَكُونَنَّ أَشْقَى خَلْقِكَ فَلاَ يَزَالُ يَدْعُو حَتَّى يَضْحَكَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ فَإِذَا ضَحِكَ مِنْهُ قَالَ لَهُ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ فَإِذَا دَخَلَهَا قَالَ اللَّهُ لَهُ تَمَنَّهْ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ رَبَّهُ وَتَمَنَّى حَتَّى إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُذَكِّرُهُ يَقُولُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، حَتَّى انْقَطَعَتْ بِهِ الأَمَانِيُّ قَالَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ لاَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ شَيْئًا حَتَّى إِذَا حَدَّثَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ ‏"‏ وَعَشَرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ مَا حَفِظْتُ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَعَشَرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ آخِرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ دُخُولاً الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏
en_text:
Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah narrated to us; Ibrahim ibn Sad narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi, from Abu Hurayrah: The people said, “Messenger of Allah, will we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?” The Messenger of Allah said: “Do you have difficulty seeing the moon on the night of the full moon?” They said, “No, Messenger of Allah.” He said: “Do you have difficulty seeing the sun when there is no cloud before it?” They said, “No, Messenger of Allah.” He said: “You will see Him in the same way. Allah will gather the people on the Day of Resurrection and say, ‘Let everyone who used to worship something follow it.’ Those who worshipped the sun will follow the sun; those who worshipped the moon will follow the moon; and those who worshipped false gods will follow them. This community will remain, including its intercessors—or its hypocrites; Ibrahim was uncertain. Allah will come to them and say, ‘I am your Lord.’ They will say, ‘We will remain here until our Lord comes to us. When our Lord comes to us, we will recognize Him.’ Then Allah will come to them in the form they recognize and say, ‘I am your Lord.’ They will say, ‘You are our Lord,’ and they will follow Him. The bridge will then be laid across the middle of Hell. I and my community will be the first to cross it. On that day, no one will speak except the Messengers, and the supplication of the Messengers that day will be: ‘O Allah, grant safety; O Allah, grant safety.’
“In Hell there will be hooks like the thorns of the sa’dan plant. Have you seen the sa’dan?” They said, “Yes, Messenger of Allah.” He said: “They are like the thorns of the sa’dan, except that no one knows how great they are except Allah. They will seize people according to their deeds. Some will be destroyed by their deeds; others will be bound by their deeds; and some will be cut up—or recompensed—or something similar.”
“Then Allah will manifest Himself. When Allah has finished judging between His servants and wishes, through His mercy, to bring out from the people of the Fire whomever He wills, He will command the angels to bring out from the Fire those who associated nothing with Allah, among those whom Allah wishes to show mercy and who testified that there is no god but Allah. The angels will recognize them in the Fire by the marks of prostration. The Fire consumes the children of Adam except the marks of prostration; Allah has forbidden the Fire to consume those marks. They will come out of the Fire burned black, then the Water of Life will be poured over them, and they will grow beneath it as a seed grows in the silt carried by a flood.
“Then Allah will finish judging between the servants. A man will remain, facing the Fire; he will be the last of the people of the Fire to enter Paradise. He will say, ‘My Lord, turn my face away from the Fire, for its stench has poisoned me and its heat has burned me.’ He will supplicate Allah as long as Allah wills, then Allah will say, ‘Perhaps, if I grant you that, you will ask Me for something else?’ He will say, ‘No, by Your might, I will ask You for nothing else.’ He will make whatever pledges and covenants with his Lord he wishes. Allah will turn his face away from the Fire. When he turns toward Paradise and sees it, he will remain silent for as long as Allah wills, then say, ‘My Lord, bring me to the gate of Paradise.’ Allah will say, ‘Did you not give Me your pledges and covenants that you would never ask Me for anything beyond what I granted you? Woe to you, son of Adam! How treacherous you are!’ He will say, ‘My Lord,’ and continue supplicating until Allah says, ‘Perhaps, if I grant you that, you will ask for something else?’ He will say, ‘No, by Your might, I will ask You for nothing else.’ He will make whatever pledges and covenants he wishes. Allah will bring him to the gate of Paradise. When he stands at the gate, Paradise will open wide for him, and he will see the joy and delight within it. He will remain silent for as long as Allah wills, then say, ‘My Lord, admit me to Paradise.’ Allah will say, ‘Did you not give Me your pledges and covenants that you would not ask for anything beyond what I granted you? Woe to you, son of Adam! How treacherous you are!’ He will say, ‘My Lord, do not make me the most wretched of Your creation.’ He will continue supplicating until Allah laughs at him. When Allah laughs at him, He will say, ‘Enter Paradise.’
“When he enters it, Allah will say to him, ‘Make a wish.’ He will ask his Lord and wish for things until Allah reminds him, saying, ‘Such-and-such,’ until his wishes are exhausted. Allah will say, ‘That is yours, and the like of it with it.’”
Ata ibn Yazid said: Abu Said al-Khudri was with Abu Hurayrah and did not object to any part of his narration. But when Abu Hurayrah narrated that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said, “That is yours, and the like of it with it,” Abu Said al-Khudri said, “And ten times as much with it, Abu Hurayrah.” Abu Hurayrah said, “I memorized only the words, ‘That is yours, and the like of it with it.’” Abu Said al-Khudri said, “I testify that I memorized from the Messenger of Allah the words, ‘That is yours, and ten times as much with it.’” Abu Hurayrah said: That man will be the last of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise.

text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تُضَارُونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الشَّمْسِ وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا كَانَتْ صَحْوًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكُمْ لاَ تُضَارُونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ رَبِّكُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ، إِلاَّ كَمَا تُضَارُونَ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِمَا ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ يُنَادِي مُنَادٍ لِيَذْهَبْ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ إِلَى مَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ‏.‏ فَيَذْهَبُ أَصْحَابُ الصَّلِيبِ مَعَ صَلِيبِهِمْ، وَأَصْحَابُ الأَوْثَانِ مَعَ أَوْثَانِهِمْ، وَأَصْحَابُ كُلِّ آلِهَةٍ مَعَ آلِهَتِهِمْ حَتَّى يَبْقَى مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَرٍّ أَوْ فَاجِرٍ، وَغُبَّرَاتٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، ثُمَّ يُؤْتَى بِجَهَنَّمَ تُعْرَضُ كَأَنَّهَا سَرَابٌ فَيُقَالُ لِلْيَهُودِ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ قَالُوا كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ عُزَيْرَ ابْنَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ كَذَبْتُمْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِلَّهِ صَاحِبَةٌ وَلاَ وَلَدٌ فَمَا تُرِيدُونَ قَالُوا نُرِيدُ أَنْ تَسْقِيَنَا، فَيُقَالُ اشْرَبُوا فَيَتَسَاقَطُونَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لِلنَّصَارَى مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ فَيَقُولُونَ كُنَّا نَعْبُدُ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ كَذَبْتُمْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِلَّهِ صَاحِبَةٌ وَلاَ وَلَدٌ، فَمَا تُرِيدُونَ فَيَقُولُونَ نُرِيدُ أَنْ تَسْقِيَنَا‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ اشْرَبُوا‏.‏ فَيَتَسَاقَطُونَ حَتَّى يَبْقَى مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَرٍّ أَوْ فَاجِرٍ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ مَا يَحْبِسُكُمْ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَ النَّاسُ فَيَقُولُونَ فَارَقْنَاهُمْ وَنَحْنُ أَحْوَجُ مِنَّا إِلَيْهِ الْيَوْمَ وَإِنَّا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِيَلْحَقْ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ‏.‏ وَإِنَّمَا نَنْتَظِرُ رَبَّنَا ـ قَالَ ـ فَيَأْتِيهِمُ الْجَبَّارُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ رَبُّنَا‏.‏ فَلاَ يُكَلِّمُهُ إِلاَّ الأَنْبِيَاءُ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ آيَةٌ تَعْرِفُونَهُ فَيَقُولُونَ السَّاقُ‏.‏ فَيَكْشِفُ عَنْ سَاقِهِ فَيَسْجُدُ لَهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ، وَيَبْقَى مَنْ كَانَ يَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ رِيَاءً وَسُمْعَةً، فَيَذْهَبُ كَيْمَا يَسْجُدَ فَيَعُودُ ظَهْرُهُ طَبَقًا وَاحِدًا، ثُمَّ يُؤْتَى بِالْجَسْرِ فَيُجْعَلُ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَىْ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا الْجَسْرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَدْحَضَةٌ مَزِلَّةٌ، عَلَيْهِ خَطَاطِيفُ وَكَلاَلِيبُ وَحَسَكَةٌ مُفَلْطَحَةٌ، لَهَا شَوْكَةٌ عُقَيْفَاءُ تَكُونُ بِنَجْدٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا السَّعْدَانُ، الْمُؤْمِنُ عَلَيْهَا كَالطَّرْفِ وَكَالْبَرْقِ وَكَالرِّيحِ وَكَأَجَاوِيدِ الْخَيْلِ وَالرِّكَابِ، فَنَاجٍ مُسَلَّمٌ وَنَاجٍ مَخْدُوشٌ وَمَكْدُوسٌ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ، حَتَّى يَمُرَّ آخِرُهُمْ يُسْحَبُ سَحْبًا، فَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِأَشَدَّ لِي مُنَاشَدَةً فِي الْحَقِّ، قَدْ تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْجَبَّارِ، وَإِذَا رَأَوْا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ نَجَوْا فِي إِخْوَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا إِخْوَانُنَا كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ مَعَنَا وَيَصُومُونَ مَعَنَا وَيَعْمَلُونَ مَعَنَا‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى اذْهَبُوا فَمَنْ وَجَدْتُمْ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ دِينَارٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ فَأَخْرِجُوهُ‏.‏ وَيُحَرِّمُ اللَّهُ صُوَرَهُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ، فَيَأْتُونَهُمْ وَبَعْضُهُمْ قَدْ غَابَ فِي النَّارِ إِلَى قَدَمِهِ وَإِلَى أَنْصَافِ سَاقَيْهِ، فَيُخْرِجُونَ مَنْ عَرَفُوا، ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ فَيَقُولُ اذْهَبُوا فَمَنْ وَجَدْتُمْ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ فَأَخْرِجُوهُ‏.‏ فَيُخْرِجُونَ مَنْ عَرَفُوا، ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ فَيَقُولُ اذْهَبُوا فَمَنْ وَجَدْتُمْ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ فَأَخْرِجُوهُ‏.‏ فَيُخْرِجُونَ مَنْ عَرَفُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ تُصَدِّقُونِي فَاقْرَءُوا ‏[quran sura="4" aya_start="27" aya_end="27"]{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ وَإِنْ تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضَاعِفْهَا‏}‏ ‏"‏ فَيَشْفَعُ النَّبِيُّونَ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ فَيَقُولُ الْجَبَّارُ بَقِيَتْ شَفَاعَتِي‏.‏ فَيَقْبِضُ قَبْضَةً مِنَ النَّارِ فَيُخْرِجُ أَقْوَامًا قَدِ امْتُحِشُوا، فَيُلْقَوْنَ فِي نَهَرٍ بِأَفْوَاهِ الْجَنَّةِ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَاءُ الْحَيَاةِ، فَيَنْبُتُونَ فِي حَافَتَيْهِ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ، قَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهَا إِلَى جَانِبِ الصَّخْرَةِ إِلَى جَانِبِ الشَّجَرَةِ، فَمَا كَانَ إِلَى الشَّمْسِ مِنْهَا كَانَ أَخْضَرَ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهَا إِلَى الظِّلِّ كَانَ أَبْيَضَ، فَيَخْرُجُونَ كَأَنَّهُمُ اللُّؤْلُؤُ، فَيُجْعَلُ فِي رِقَابِهِمُ الْخَوَاتِيمُ فَيَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ فَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ هَؤُلاَءِ عُتَقَاءُ الرَّحْمَنِ أَدْخَلَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ بِغَيْرِ عَمَلٍ عَمِلُوهُ وَلاَ خَيْرٍ قَدَّمُوهُ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ لَكُمْ مَا رَأَيْتُمْ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text:
Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us; al-Layth narrated to us, from Khalid ibn Yazid, from Said ibn Abi Hilal, from Zayd, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Said al-Khudri, who said: We said, “Messenger of Allah, will we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?” He said: “Do you have difficulty seeing the sun and moon when the sky is clear?” We said, “No.” He said: “You will have no difficulty seeing your Lord that day, any more than you have difficulty seeing those two.”
“Then a caller will call out: ‘Let every people follow what they used to worship.’ The worshippers of the cross will go with their cross; the worshippers of idols will go with their idols; and the worshippers of every deity will go with their deities. Only those who used to worship Allah, whether righteous or wicked, and a remnant of the People of the Book will remain. Then Hell will be brought forward, appearing like a mirage. It will be said to the Jews, ‘What did you worship?’ They will say, ‘We worshipped Uzayr, the son of Allah.’ It will be said, ‘You have lied. Allah has no wife and no child. What do you want?’ They will say, ‘We want You to give us drink.’ It will be said, ‘Drink,’ and they will fall into Hell. Then it will be said to the Christians, ‘What did you worship?’ They will say, ‘We worshipped the Messiah, the son of Allah.’ It will be said, ‘You have lied. Allah has no wife and no child. What do you want?’ They will say, ‘We want You to give us drink.’ It will be said, ‘Drink,’ and they will fall into Hell.
“Only those who used to worship Allah, whether righteous or wicked, will remain. It will be said to them, ‘What is keeping you here when the people have gone?’ They will say, ‘We parted from them when we needed them more than we ever do today. We heard a caller calling for every people to follow what they used to worship, and we are waiting for our Lord.’ He said: The Compeller will come to them and say, ‘I am your Lord.’ They will say, ‘You are our Lord.’ No one will speak to Him except the Prophets. He will say, ‘Is there a sign between you and Him by which you will recognize Him?’ They will say, ‘The shin.’ Then He will uncover His shin, and every believer will prostrate to Him. Those who used to prostrate to Allah for show and reputation will remain; they will go to prostrate, but their backs will become like one solid plate.”
“Then the bridge will be brought and placed across the middle of Hell.” We said, “Messenger of Allah, what is the bridge?” He said: “A slippery, treacherous crossing, with hooks, barbs, and a flattened thorn with a curved point, like the sa’dan thorn found in Najd. The believer will cross it like a glance, like lightning, like the wind, and like the finest horses and camels. One will pass safely; another will be scratched; another will be thrown headlong into the Fire of Hell. The last of them will be dragged across.”
“By Allah, you will press me no harder to secure a right than the believers will press the Compeller for their brothers on that day, when it has become clear to them who the believers are. They will say, ‘Our Lord, our brothers used to pray with us, fast with us, and do good deeds with us.’ Allah Most High will say, ‘Go and bring out anyone in whose heart you find faith weighing a dinar.’ Allah will forbid their faces to the Fire. They will go to them, while some of them have sunk into the Fire up to their feet or halfway up their shins, and they will bring out those they recognize. Then they will return, and He will say, ‘Go and bring out anyone in whose heart you find faith weighing half a dinar.’ They will bring out those they recognize. Then they will return, and He will say, ‘Go and bring out anyone in whose heart you find faith weighing an atom.’ They will bring out those they recognize.” Abu Said said: If you do not believe me, then recite: “Indeed, Allah does not wrong even the weight of an atom, and if there is a good deed, He multiplies it” (4:27).
“The Prophets, the angels, and the believers will intercede. Then the Compeller will say, ‘My intercession remains.’ He will seize a handful from the Fire and bring out people who have been burned black. They will be cast into a river at the entrances of Paradise, called the Water of Life. They will grow on its banks as a seed grows in the silt carried by a flood. You have seen it beside a rock or beside a tree: what faces the sun grows green, while what faces the shade grows white. They will emerge like pearls, and signet rings will be placed around their necks. They will enter Paradise, and the people of Paradise will say, ‘These are those whom the Most Merciful has freed; He admitted them to Paradise without any deeds they performed or good they sent ahead.’ It will be said to them, ‘You have what you have seen, and its like with it.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7440, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: وَقَالَ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يُحْبَسُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُهِمُّوا بِذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُونَ لَوِ اسْتَشْفَعْنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا فَيُرِيحُنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ آدَمُ أَبُو النَّاسِ خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ وَأَسْكَنَكَ جَنَّتَهُ، وَأَسْجَدَ لَكَ مَلاَئِكَتَهُ، وَعَلَّمَكَ أَسْمَاءَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ، لِتَشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ حَتَّى يُرِيحَنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا هَذَا، قَالَ فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ قَالَ وَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ أَكْلَهُ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ وَقَدْ نُهِيَ عَنْهَا ـ وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا نُوحًا أَوَّلَ نَبِيٍّ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ سُؤَالَهُ رَبَّهُ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ـ وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلَ الرَّحْمَنِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَيَقُولُ إِنِّي لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ ثَلاَثَ كَلِمَاتٍ كَذَبَهُنَّ ـ وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا مُوسَى عَبْدًا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ التَّوْرَاةَ وَكَلَّمَهُ وَقَرَّبَهُ نَجِيًّا‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى فَيَقُولُ إِنِّي لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ ـ وَيَذْكُرُ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ قَتْلَهُ النَّفْسَ ـ وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا عِيسَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولَهُ وَرُوحَ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدًا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونِي فَأَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَى رَبِّي فِي دَارِهِ فَيُؤْذَنُ لِي عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُهُ وَقَعْتُ سَاجِدًا فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَدَعَنِي فَيَقُولُ ارْفَعْ مُحَمَّدُ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي فَأُثْنِي عَلَى رَبِّي بِثَنَاءٍ وَتَحْمِيدٍ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ، فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَسَمِعْتُهُ أَيْضًا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَعُودُ فَأَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَى رَبِّي فِي دَارِهِ فَيُؤْذَنُ لِي عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُهُ وَقَعْتُ سَاجِدًا فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَدَعَنِي ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ارْفَعْ مُحَمَّدُ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي فَأُثْنِي عَلَى رَبِّي بِثَنَاءٍ وَتَحْمِيدٍ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ ـ قَالَ ـ ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَعُودُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَأَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَى رَبِّي فِي دَارِهِ فَيُؤْذَنُ لِي عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُهُ وَقَعْتُ سَاجِدًا فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَدَعَنِي ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ارْفَعْ مُحَمَّدُ، وَقُلْ يُسْمَعْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي فَأُثْنِي عَلَى رَبِّي بِثَنَاءٍ وَتَحْمِيدٍ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ ـ قَالَ ـ ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، حَتَّى مَا يَبْقَى فِي النَّارِ إِلاَّ مَنْ حَبَسَهُ الْقُرْآنُ أَىْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْخُلُودُ ـ قَالَ ـ ثُمَّ تَلاَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏[quran sura="17" aya_start="79" aya_end="79"]{‏عَسَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا‏}‏ قَالَ وَهَذَا الْمَقَامُ الْمَحْمُودُ الَّذِي وُعِدَهُ نَبِيُّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text:
Hajjaj ibn Minhal said: Hammam ibn Yahya narrated to us; Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas, may Allah be pleased with him, that the Prophet said: “The believers will be held back on the Day of Resurrection until they become distressed by their situation. They will say, ‘If only we could seek an intercessor with our Lord so He would relieve us from this place.’ They will go to Adam and say, ‘You are Adam, the father of humanity. Allah created you with His Hand, settled you in His Paradise, made His angels prostrate to you, and taught you the names of everything. Intercede for us with your Lord so He will relieve us from this place.’ He will say, ‘I am not the one for this,’ and mention the sin he committed: he ate from the tree after being forbidden to do so. ‘But go to Noah, the first prophet Allah sent to the people of the earth.’
“They will go to Noah, and he will say, ‘I am not the one for this,’ and mention the sin he committed: he asked his Lord about something of which he had no knowledge. ‘But go to Abraham, the beloved of the Most Merciful.’ They will go to Abraham, and he will say, ‘I am not the one for this,’ and mention three statements he had made. ‘But go to Moses, a servant to whom Allah gave the Torah, spoke to, and brought near in intimate conversation.’ They will go to Moses, and he will say, ‘I am not the one for this,’ and mention the sin he committed: he killed a person. ‘But go to Jesus, Allah’s servant, Messenger, spirit, and word.’ They will go to Jesus, and he will say, ‘I am not the one for this. Go to Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, a servant whose past and future sins Allah has forgiven.’
“They will come to me, and I will ask my Lord for permission to enter His presence. Permission will be given to me. When I see Him, I will fall down in prostration. He will leave me as long as Allah wills, then say, ‘Raise your head, Muhammad. Speak and you will be heard; intercede and your intercession will be accepted; ask and you will be given.’ I will raise my head and praise my Lord with praise and glorification that He will teach me. He will set a limit for me, and I will go out and admit them into Paradise.”
Qatadah said: I also heard the Prophet say: “I will go out and bring them out of the Fire and admit them into Paradise. Then I will return and ask my Lord for permission to enter His presence. Permission will be given to me. When I see Him, I will fall down in prostration. He will leave me as long as Allah wills, then say, ‘Raise your head, Muhammad. Speak and you will be heard; intercede and your intercession will be accepted; ask and you will be given.’ I will raise my head and praise my Lord with praise and glorification that He will teach me.” He said: “Then I will intercede. He will set a limit for me, and I will go out and admit them into Paradise.” Qatadah said: I heard the Prophet say: “I will go out and bring them out of the Fire and admit them into Paradise. Then I will return a third time and ask my Lord for permission to enter His presence. Permission will be given to me. When I see Him, I will fall down in prostration. He will leave me as long as Allah wills, then say, ‘Raise your head, Muhammad. Speak and you will be heard; intercede and your intercession will be accepted; ask and you will be given.’ I will raise my head and praise my Lord with praise and glorification that He will teach me.” He said: “Then I will intercede. He will set a limit for me, and I will go out and admit them into Paradise.”
Qatadah said: I heard the Prophet say: “I will go out and bring them out of the Fire and admit them into Paradise, until no one remains in the Fire except those whom the Quran has confined there”—that is, those for whom eternal residence has become due. Then he recited this verse: “It may be that your Lord will raise you to a praised station” (17:79). He said: “This is the praised station that your Prophet was promised.”

text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْسَلَ إِلَى الأَنْصَارِ فَجَمَعَهُمْ فِي قُبَّةٍ وَقَالَ لَهُمُ ‏"‏ اصْبِرُوا حَتَّى تَلْقَوُا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، فَإِنِّي عَلَى الْحَوْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ubai­dullah ibn Sa‘d ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: My paternal uncle narrated to me; my father narrated to us, from Salih, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Anas ibn Malik narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah sent for the Ansar, gathered them in a pavilion, and said, “Be patient until you meet Allah and His Messenger, for I will be at the Hawd.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7442, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي ثَابِتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا تَهَجَّدَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَبِكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَأَسْرَرْتُ وَأَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ وَأَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَيَّامٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ الْقَيُّومُ الْقَائِمُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ‏.‏ وَقَرَأَ عُمَرُ الْقَيَّامُ، وَكِلاَهُمَا مَدْحٌ‏.‏
en_text: Thabit ibn Muhammad narrated to me: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, who said: When the Prophet prayed at night, he would say, “O Allah, our Lord, praise belongs to You. You sustain the heavens and earth, and You are Lord and Light of the heavens and earth and all in them. You are the Truth; Your word, promise, meeting You, Paradise, the Fire, and the Hour are true. O Allah, to You I submit, in You I believe, upon You I rely, to You I turn in dispute, and by You I judge. Forgive what I sent ahead and left behind, concealed and declared, and what You know better than I. There is no god but You.” Abu Abdullah said: Qays ibn Sa‘d and Abu al-Zubayr reported from Tawus “Qayyam.” Mujahid said “Al-Qayyum” means the One standing over everything. Umar recited “Al-Qayyam”; both are praise.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7443, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ سَيُكَلِّمُهُ رَبُّهُ، لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ تُرْجُمَانٌ وَلاَ حِجَابٌ يَحْجُبُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yusuf ibn Musa narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us: Al-A‘mash narrated to me, from Khaythamah, from Adi ibn Hatim, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “There is none of you except that his Lord will speak to him, with no interpreter between them and no veil screening Him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7444, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ جَنَّتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَجَنَّتَانِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ آنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَمَا بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلاَّ رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Abdullah narrated to us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abd al-Samad narrated to us, from Abu Imran, from Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Qays, from his father, from the Prophet, who said, “Two gardens will have vessels of silver and everything in them of silver, and two gardens will have vessels of gold and everything in them of gold. Between the people and seeing their Lord there will be nothing but the cloak of grandeur upon His Face in the Garden of Eden.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7445, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، وَجَامِعُ بْنُ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينٍ كَاذِبَةٍ، لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَهْوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِصْدَاقَهُ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ ‏[quran sura="3" aya_start="77" aya_end="77"]{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلاً أُولَئِكَ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ وَلاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Humaydi narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us: Abd al-Malik ibn A‘yan and Jami ibn Abi Rashid narrated to us, from Abu Wa’il, from Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “Whoever takes a Muslim’s property by a false oath will meet Allah while He is angry with him.” Abdullah said: The Messenger of Allah then recited as confirmation from the Book of Allah: “Those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah’s covenant and their oaths will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allah will not speak to them…” Quran 3:77.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7446, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ رَجُلٌ حَلَفَ عَلَى سِلْعَةٍ لَقَدْ أَعْطَى بِهَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا أَعْطَى وَهْوَ كَاذِبٌ، وَرَجُلٌ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ كَاذِبَةٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ لِيَقْتَطِعَ بِهَا مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ، وَرَجُلٌ مَنَعَ فَضْلَ مَاءٍ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، الْيَوْمَ أَمْنَعُكَ فَضْلِي، كَمَا مَنَعْتَ فَضْلَ مَا لَمْ تَعْمَلْ يَدَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, who said, “There are three whom Allah will not speak to or look at on the Day of Resurrection: a man who falsely swears about a commodity that he was offered more for it than he was; a man who swears a false oath after Asr to take a Muslim’s property; and a man who withholds surplus water. Allah will say, ‘Today I will withhold My bounty from you, just as you withheld the surplus of what your hands did not make.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7447, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الزَّمَانُ قَدِ اسْتَدَارَ كَهَيْئَتِهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ، السَّنَةُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا، مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ثَلاَثٌ مُتَوَالِيَاتٌ ذُو الْقَعَدَةِ وَذُو الْحَجَّةِ وَالْمُحَرَّمُ، وَرَجَبُ مُضَرَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ جُمَادَى وَشَعْبَانَ، أَىُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ يُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ ذَا الْحَجَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَىُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ الْبَلْدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ ـ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ ـ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ، كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا، وَسَتَلْقَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ، أَلاَ فَلاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي ضُلاَّلاً، يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ، أَلاَ لِيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ، فَلَعَلَّ بَعْضَ مَنْ يَبْلُغُهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَوْعَى مِنْ بَعْضِ مَنْ سَمِعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ إِذَا ذَكَرَهُ قَالَ صَدَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ أَلاَ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us: Ayyub narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Bakrah, from Abu Bakrah, from the Prophet, who said, “Time has returned to its original form as on the day Allah created the heavens and earth. The year has twelve months, four sacred: three in succession, Dhu al-Qadah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and al-Muharram, and Rajab of Mudar between Jumada and Sha‘ban.” He asked, “What month is this?” We said, “Allah and His Messenger know best.” He remained silent until we thought he would name it differently, then said, “Is it not Dhu al-Hijjah?” We said yes. He asked, “What land is this?” We said, “Allah and His Messenger know best.” He remained silent until we thought he would name it differently, then said, “Is it not the Sacred Land?” We said yes. He asked, “What day is this?” We said, “Allah and His Messenger know best.” He remained silent until we thought he would name it differently, then said, “Is it not the Day of Sacrifice?” We said yes. He said, “Your blood and property”—Muhammad said, “I think he also said your honor”—“are sacred to you, like the sanctity of this day, in this land, in this month. You will meet your Lord and He will ask you about your deeds. Do not return after me to misguidance, striking one another’s necks. Let those present convey this to the absent; perhaps some who receive it will understand it better than some who heard it.” Whenever Muhammad mentioned it, he said, “The Prophet spoke the truth,” then, “Have I conveyed it? Have I conveyed it?”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7448, book 97, باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏إِنَّ رَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنٌ لِبَعْضِ بَنَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْضِي، فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهَا فَأَرْسَلَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلٌّ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ فَأَقْسَمَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقُمْتُ مَعَهُ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَعُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلْنَا نَاوَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّبِيَّ وَنَفْسُهُ تَقَلْقَلُ فِي صَدْرِهِ ـ حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ ـ كَأَنَّهَا شَنَّةٌ، فَبَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ أَتَبْكِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الرُّحَمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musa ibn Ismail narrated to us: Abd al-Wahid narrated to us: Asim narrated to us, from Abu Uthman, from Usamah, who said: A son of one of the Prophet’s daughters was dying, so she sent for him. He sent word, “To Allah belongs what He takes and gives, and everything has an appointed term. Be patient and seek reward.” She sent for him again and adjured him to come. The Messenger of Allah rose, and I rose with him, along with Muadh ibn Jabal, Ubayy ibn Ka‘b, and Ubadah ibn al-Samit. When we entered, they handed the child to him while his breath rattled in his chest—I think he said it was like an old waterskin. The Messenger of Allah wept. Sa‘d ibn Ubadah said, “Are you weeping?” He replied, “Allah shows mercy only to those of His servants who are merciful.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7449, book 97, باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏إِنَّ رَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اخْتَصَمَتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ إِلَى رَبِّهِمَا فَقَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ يَا رَبِّ مَا لَهَا لاَ يَدْخُلُهَا إِلاَّ ضُعَفَاءُ النَّاسِ وَسَقَطُهُمْ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ النَّارُ ـ يَعْنِي ـ أُوثِرْتُ بِالْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِلْجَنَّةِ أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِلنَّارِ أَنْتِ عَذَابِي أُصِيبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ، وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمَا مِلْؤُهَا ـ قَالَ ـ فَأَمَّا الْجَنَّةُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ أَحَدًا، وَإِنَّهُ يُنْشِئُ لِلنَّارِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَيُلْقَوْنَ فِيهَا فَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا، حَتَّى يَضَعَ فِيهَا قَدَمَهُ فَتَمْتَلِئُ وَيُرَدُّ بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ وَتَقُولُ قَطْ قَطْ قَطْ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ubai­dullah ibn Sa‘d ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Ya‘qub narrated to us: My father narrated to us, from Salih ibn Kaysan, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, who said, “Paradise and the Fire disputed before their Lord. Paradise said, ‘My Lord, why do only the weak and lowly among people enter me?’ The Fire said, ‘I have been favored with the arrogant.’ Allah said to Paradise, ‘You are My mercy,’ and to the Fire, ‘You are My punishment; through you I punish whom I will. Each of you will be filled.’ Allah does not wrong any of His creation. He will create for the Fire whom He wills, and they will be cast into it. It will say, ‘Is there any more?’ three times, until He places His Foot in it; then it will be filled, its parts will draw together, and it will say, ‘Enough, enough, enough.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7450, book 97, باب مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏إِنَّ رَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيُصِيبَنَّ أَقْوَامًا سَفْعٌ مِنَ النَّارِ بِذُنُوبٍ أَصَابُوهَا عُقُوبَةً، ثُمَّ يُدْخِلُهُمُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ يُقَالُ لَهُمُ الْجَهَنَّمِيُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: Hafs ibn Umar narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet, who said, “Some people will be touched by the scorching of the Fire as punishment for sins they committed. Then Allah will admit them to Paradise by His mercy, and they will be called the Jahannamiyyun.” Hammam said: Qatadah narrated to us: Anas narrated to us, from the Prophet.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7451, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولاَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ حَبْرٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَضَعُ السَّمَاءَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالأَرْضَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالْجِبَالَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالشَّجَرَ وَالأَنْهَارَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَسَائِرَ الْخَلْقِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ بِيَدِهِ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ ‏[quran sura="6" aya_start="91" aya_end="91"]{‏وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ‏}‏‏"‏
en_text: Musa narrated to us: Abu Awanah narrated to us, from al-A‘mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah, who said: A Jewish scholar came to the Messenger of Allah and said, “O Muhammad, Allah will place the heaven on one finger, the earth on one finger, the mountains on one finger, the trees and rivers on one finger, and all the rest of creation on one finger. Then He will say with His hand, ‘I am the King.’” The Messenger of Allah laughed and said, “They have not appraised Allah with the appraisal due to Him” Quran 6:91.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7452, book 97, باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِنَ الْخَلاَئِقِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بِتُّ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ لَيْلَةً وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا لأَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِاللَّيْلِ، فَتَحَدَّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أَهْلِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَقَدَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ أَوْ بَعْضُهُ قَعَدَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَرَأَ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="164" aya_end="164"]{‏إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏لأُولِي الأَلْبَابِ‏}‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَاسْتَنَّ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى لِلنَّاسِ الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
en_text: Sa‘id ibn Abi Maryam narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja‘far informed us: Sharik ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Namir informed me, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas, who said: I spent a night in Maymunah’s house while the Prophet was there, to see how he prayed at night. He spoke with his family for a while, then slept. During the last third of the night, or some of it, he sat up, looked at the sky, and recited, “Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and earth…” through “for people of understanding” Quran 2:164. Then he got up, performed ablution, and used a tooth-stick. He prayed eleven rak‘ahs. Bilal called the prayer, and he prayed two units, then went out and led the dawn prayer.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7453, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ عَرْشِهِ، إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي سَبَقَتْ غَضَبِي ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to us: Malik narrated to me, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said, “When Allah had finished creating creation, He wrote with Him above His Throne: ‘My mercy preceded My anger.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7454, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ الصَّادِقُ الْمَصْدُوقُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ خَلْقَ أَحَدِكُمْ يُجْمَعُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا وَأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً، ثُمَّ يَكُونُ عَلَقَةً مِثْلَهُ، ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مُضْغَةً مِثْلَهُ، ثُمَّ يُبْعَثُ إِلَيْهِ الْمَلَكُ فَيُؤْذَنُ بِأَرْبَعِ كَلِمَاتٍ، فَيَكْتُبُ رِزْقَهُ وَأَجَلَهُ وَعَمَلَهُ وَشَقِيٌّ أَمْ سَعِيدٌ ثُمَّ يَنْفُخُ فِيهِ الرُّوحَ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، حَتَّى لاَ يَكُونُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُ إِلاَّ ذِرَاعٌ، فَيَسْبِقُ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابُ، فَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَيَدْخُلُ النَّارَ، وَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، حَتَّى مَا يَكُونُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُ إِلاَّ ذِرَاعٌ فَيَسْبِقُ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابُ، فَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَيَدْخُلُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Adam narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us: Al-A‘mash narrated to us: I heard Zayd ibn Wahb say: I heard Abdullah ibn Mas‘ud say: The Messenger of Allah, the truthful one who was believed, narrated to us: “Each of you is formed in his mother’s womb for forty days and forty nights, then is a clinging clot for the same, then a lump of flesh for the same. Then the angel is sent and commanded to write four things: his provision, lifespan, deeds, and whether he will be wretched or blessed. Then the soul is breathed into him. A man may act with the deeds of the people of Paradise until only an arm’s length remains between him and it, but what was written overtakes him, so he acts with the deeds of the people of the Fire and enters it. A man may act with the deeds of the people of the Fire until only an arm’s length remains between him and it, but what was written overtakes him, so he acts with the deeds of the people of Paradise and enters it.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7455, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا جِبْرِيلُ مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تَزُورَنَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا تَزُورُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏[quran sura="19" aya_start="64" aya_end="64"]{‏وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلاَّ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا كَانَ الْجَوَابَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: Khallad ibn Yahya narrated to us: Umar ibn Dharr narrated to us: I heard my father narrate, from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that the Prophet said, “O Gabriel, what prevents you from visiting us more often?” Then this was revealed: “We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us…” to the end of the verse Quran 19:64. He said: This was the answer to Muhammad.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7456, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرْثٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَهْوَ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ، فَمَرَّ بِقَوْمٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ سَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ تَسْأَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ‏.‏ فَسَأَلُوهُ فَقَامَ مُتَوَكِّئًا عَلَى الْعَسِيبِ وَأَنَا خَلْفَهُ، فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏[quran sura="17" aya_start="85" aya_end="85"]{‏وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏}‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ قَدْ قُلْنَا لَكُمْ لاَ تَسْأَلُوهُ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya narrated to us: Waki‘ narrated to us, from al-A‘mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah, who said: I was walking with the Messenger of Allah in a cultivated area in Medina while he leaned on a palm stalk. He passed a group of Jews, and some said, “Ask him about the Spirit.” Others said, “Do not ask him.” They asked him, so he stood leaning on the stalk, and I was behind him. I thought revelation was coming to him, and he said, “They ask you about the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is of the command of my Lord, and you have been given only a little knowledge” Quran 17:85. Some of them said to one another, “We told you not to ask him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7457, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَكَفَّلَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ جَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ، لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ إِلاَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ، وَتَصْدِيقُ كَلِمَاتِهِ، بِأَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ، أَوْ يَرْجِعَهُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ، مَعَ مَا نَالَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to me: Malik narrated to me, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said, “Allah has undertaken the care of the one who strives in His cause; nothing takes him out except striving in His cause and belief in His words: either He admits him to Paradise or returns him to the home from which he departed with the reward or booty he gained.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7458, book 97, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ حَمِيَّةً وَيُقَاتِلُ شَجَاعَةً وَيُقَاتِلُ رِيَاءً، فَأَىُّ ذَلِكَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَاتَلَ لِتَكُونَ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا، فَهْوَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Kathir narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A‘mash, from Abu Wa’il, from Abu Musa, who said: A man came to the Prophet and said, “A man fights out of zeal, another bravely, and another to be seen. Which is in Allah’s cause?” He said, “Whoever fights so that the word of Allah is supreme is in Allah’s cause.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7459, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ‏ إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون}‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَزَالُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي قَوْمٌ ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى النَّاسِ، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُمْ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Shihab ibn Abbad narrated to us: Ibrahim ibn Humayd narrated to us, from Ismail, from Qays, from al-Mughirah ibn Shu‘bah, who said: I heard the Prophet say, “There will always be a group from my community prevailing over the people until Allah’s command comes to them.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7460, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ‏ إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون}‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جَابِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَزَالُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ، مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ كَذَّبَهُمْ، وَلاَ مَنْ خَالَفَهُمْ، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَالِكُ بْنُ يُخَامِرَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاذًا يَقُولُ وَهُمْ بِالشَّأْمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ هَذَا مَالِكٌ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاذًا يَقُولُ وَهُمْ بِالشَّأْمِ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Humaydi narrated to us: al-Walid ibn Muslim narrated to us: Ibn Jabir narrated to us: Umayr ibn Hani narrated to me that he heard Muawiyah say: I heard the Prophet say, “There will always be a community from my people standing by Allah’s command. Those who deny them and those who oppose them will not harm them, until Allah’s command comes while they remain so.” Malik ibn Yakhamir said, “I heard Muadh say, ‘They are in Syria.’” Muawiyah said, “This is Malik claiming that he heard Muadh say that they are in Syria.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7461, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ‏ إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون}‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ وَقَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مُسَيْلِمَةَ فِي أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ سَأَلْتَنِي هَذِهِ الْقِطْعَةَ مَا أَعْطَيْتُكَهَا، وَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ، وَلَئِنْ أَدْبَرْتَ لَيَعْقِرَنَّكَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us: Shu‘ayb informed us, from Abdullah ibn Abi Husayn: Nafi ibn Jubayr narrated to us, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Prophet stood before Musaylimah among his companions and said, “If you asked me for this piece, I would not give it to you. You will not go beyond what Allah has decreed for you; and if you turn away, Allah will surely strike you down.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7462, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ‏ إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون}‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي، مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ حَرْثِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَهْوَ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ مَعَهُ، فَمَرَرْنَا عَلَى نَفَرٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ سَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ تَسْأَلُوهُ أَنْ يَجِيءَ فِيهِ بِشَىْءٍ تَكْرَهُونَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ مَا الرُّوحُ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ [quran sura="17" aya_start="85" aya_end="85"]‏{‏وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتُوا مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ هَكَذَا فِي قِرِاءَتِنَا‏.‏
en_text: Musa ibn Ismail narrated to us, from Abd al-Wahid, from al-A‘mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Ibn Mas‘ud, who said: As I walked with the Prophet in one of Medina’s cultivated areas while he leaned on a palm stalk he carried, we passed some Jews. Some said, “Ask him about the Spirit.” Others said, “Do not ask him, lest he tell you something you dislike.” Some said, “We will ask him.” One stood and said, “O Abu al-Qasim, what is the Spirit?” The Prophet was silent, and I knew revelation was coming. He said, “They ask you about the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is of the command of my Lord, and you have been given only a little knowledge” Quran 17:85. Al-A‘mash said: This is how it is in our recitation.
